title: Reactome named as a Global Core Biodata Resource
body:
##  Reactome named as a Global Core Biodata Resource 

On December 15, the Global Biodata Coalition ([](<https://globalbiodata.org/>)<https://globalbiodata.org/>) of research funders recognized the Reactome Knowledgebase ([www.reactome.org](<http://www.reactome.org/>)) as one of just 37 resources worldwide whose long-term funding and sustainability are critical to life science and biomedical research. See the full announcement [here](<https://globalbiodata.org/global-biodata-coalition-announces-the-first-set-of-global-core-biodata-resources/>).

Many thanks to the selection panel at GBC for the recognition, and congratulations to the other resources who were selected.
